name: Aisha Bello
sketch: Freelance journalist on housing and local government, files the occasional science feature. Lives in Brookland, works out of the Wilson Building press room and coffee shops. Chases agendas and FOIA logs, and wants to know when her name comes up.

name: Devika "Dev" Rao
sketch: Owns Ridgeline Roasters: two cafes (S Broadway in Baker, Welton St in Five Points), eleven staff, roasts on a Probat P12 in the back of the Baker shop. Thin margins, thinner time. Wants her agent to filter hard and interrupt rarely, but a wholesale lead or a bad review needs to reach her the same day.

name: Earl Whitcomb
sketch: Retired lineman on five acres. Fixes everything himself, buys used, sells used, barters eggs and syrup. Will drive an hour for the right deal. Wants parts, tools, lumber, a specific implement for his Kubota, workshops at the tech college in Randolph Center, and firewood in before October.

name: Grace Liang
sketch: Retired librarian in the Outer Sunset. Attends public meetings, volunteers, walks everywhere, on a fixed income. Keeps lists: ramen places, free classes, things the city says it will do.

name: Jordan Feld
sketch: Parent of a 4-year-old and a 7-year-old, works hybrid, runs the family logistics from a phone between meetings. Cares most about safety stuff and anything that fills a weekend. Wants to be told once, early, and not spammed.

name: Kai Delacroix
sketch: Session and touring bassist, electric and upright. On the road about a third of the year, so 'near me' changes every week. Always hunting paid gigs, vintage gear at a fair price, and a van that will not die in Iowa.

name: Dr. Lena Marsh
sketch: Astrobiologist running a small group at a research lab. Reads preprints every morning, reviews for two journals, three conferences a year. Parent of a ten-year-old who wants the lab's outreach nights, public star parties, and a decent used telescope for the back yard.

name: Maya Okafor
sketch: Goes to two or three shows a month, mostly electronic and indie. Hates missing presales. Has a group chat that expects her to know first. Also likes small-room comedy and the occasional Red Sox game when a friend has tickets.

name: Nadia Kowalczyk
sketch: Runs Ironbound Courier, three people and two vans out of Newark's Ironbound, doing same-day work across north Jersey and the five boroughs. A persistent operations agent (@ironbound-ops) checks Crier every hour on standing orders; she reads its digest between runs and hates being woken for lane closures.

name: Priya Venkatesan
sketch: Junior in computer science at a university in Lincoln Park. Broke, busy, social. Lives on the Brown Line, eats whatever is free, applies to everything with a stipend, and is currently trying to get to Ann Arbor for a football weekend without a car.

name: Ravi Chandrasekaran
sketch: Collects vintage synthesizers and first-press vinyl. Patient and specific: knows the revisions, the matrix numbers and the aliases, and will drive to Buffalo or pay cross-border shipping for the right thing. Thinks in CAD and kilometres. Owns two MS-20s.

name: Sam Lindqvist
sketch: Backend engineer, fully remote, Rust and Postgres all day. Maintains backstop, a mid-sized idempotency-key crate for axum and tower, mostly alone. Runs a persistent coding agent that checks Crier on a schedule and queues things for Monday. Goes to one meetup a month and would like it to be a hack night.

name: Tomás Herrera
sketch: Austin FC season ticket holder (Los Verdes-adjacent, sits in the regular seats), Longhorns football every Saturday, Spurs fan from afar. Sunday pickup soccer and a Sunday-league team he captains, Tuesday rec-league basketball. Commissioner of a twelve-team fantasy football league. Lives on East Cesar Chavez, drives a beat-up Tacoma, will travel for a match.
